# Erdos.p233 — Erdős problem 233

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/233
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/233.lean`, theorem `erdos_233`, AMS 11).

A conjecture by Heath-Brown:
The sum of squares of the first $N$ gaps between consecutive primes behaves like $N * (log N)^2$.

## Statement
(fun N => ((∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (primeGap n) ^ 2) : ℝ)) =O[atTop] fun N => N * (log N)^2

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
